title: Chromosome Conformation Capture with Nuclear Titrated Capture-C (NuTi Capture-C)
protocol: Pre-cool large centrifuge to 4°C.
Chill glycine, PBS, and lysis buffer.
Collect cells from tissue or culture and make single-cell suspensions of cells at a concentration of 5 x 10^6 cells in 5 mL of growth media.
Add 270 µL 37% formaldehyde to the cell suspension and incubate for 10 min at room temperature while tumbling (final concentration of 2%).
Quench by adding 750 µL cold glycine solution (make it 1/8th of the final volume, resulting in a 125 mM final concentration).
Centrifuge cell suspension for 10 min at 500 rcf (4°C).
Wash pellet by gently re-suspending it in 5 mL cold PBS.
Centrifuge washed cells for 10 min at 500 rcf (4°C), and remove supernatant carefully without disturbing the cell pellet.
Re-suspend the pellet in 5 mL ice-cold lysis buffer.
Incubate cell suspension for 20 min on ice.
Centrifuge cell suspension for 10 min at 500 rcf (4°C) and gently remove the supernatant.
Wash the cell pellet by re-suspending it gently in 5 mL cold PBS.
Centrifuge washed cells for 10 min at 500 rcf (4°C), carefully removing the supernatant.
Re-suspend the pellet in 1 mL of PBS and transfer to a 1.7 mL microtube.
Snap freeze the tube using ethanol and dry ice or liquid nitrogen.
Store fixed cells at -80°C for long-term storage.
Defrost fixed cells on ice.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 500 rcf (4°C).
Gently remove supernatant without disturbing pellet.
Re-suspend pellet in 215 µL 1x DpnII buffer.
Transfer 15 µL to a new tube for the undigested control (Control 1).
To the remaining 200 µL of sample add, in order: 437 µL of water, 60 µL of 10x Restriction buffer, and 10 µL of 20% SDS (0.28% final conc.).
To Control 1 add, 227.5 µL of water, 28.5 µL of 10x Restriction buffer, and 4 µL of 20% SDS.
Shake horizontally at 500 rpm (intermittent: 30s on / 30s off) for 1 hr at 37°C using Eppendorf ThermoMixer to permeabilize the nuclei.
Neutralise the SDS by adding 66 µL of 20% Triton X-100 to the digestion and 25 µL to Control 1 (1.67% final conc.).
Shake horizontally for 1 hr at 37°C, 500 rpm (intermittent: 30s on / 30s off).
Add 10 µL DpnII restriction enzyme (500U) to the digestion sample.
Shake horizontally for 2-3 hrs at 37°C, 500 rpm (intermittent: 30s on / 30s off).
Add a further 10 µL DpnII (500 U) and incubate overnight at 37°C.
The following morning add a final 10 µL of DpnII and incubate for another 5-6 hours.
Take 100 µL from the digestion reaction to make Control 2 (Digested, un-ligated control).
Add 200 µL PCR grade water to Control 2.
Store both Control 1 and Control 2 at -20°C until required.
Place the digests on a 65°C block for 15 min to heat inactivate DpnII.
Immediately cool digests on ice.
Cool the Eppendorf ThermoMixer to 16°C.
Add 500 µL water and 134 µL 10x Ligation buffer to the digest.
Add 8 µL T4 Ligase (240 U).
Incubate at 16°C for ~22 hrs while shaking, 500 rpm (intermittent: 30s on / 30s off).
Pellet nuclei by centrifugation at 500 rcf for 15 min (room temp).
Gently remove all of the supernatant without disturbing nuclear pellet, and transfer to a new tube.
Store the retained supernatant as a safe guard in case pellet was difficult to visualize and was disturbed.
Resuspend nuclear pellet in 300 µL of TE buffer.
Add 5 µl Proteinase K (3 U).
Remove Control 1 and Control 2 from freezer.
Add 3 µL of Proteinase K (1.8 U) to each control.
Incubate 3C library, Control 1, and Control 2 at 65°C overnight.
Cool samples to 37°C.
Add 5 µL RNAse (7.5 mU) to each tube.
Incubate 30 min at 37°C on a thermomixer (500 rpm, intermittent: 30s on / 30s off).
Prepare PhaseLock tubes by spinning at 5,000 rcf for 2 min.
Add 310 μL phenol-chloroform isoamyl alcohol (PCI) to each sample.
Vortex thoroughly to mix.
Transfer each sample to a PhaseLock tube and centrifuge for 10 min at 12,600 rcf (room temperature).
Transfer the upper layer to a new microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the viscous interface.
Add 30 μL of 3M sodium acetate (NaOAc) and 1 μL of glycoblue.
Mix by inversion.
Add 900 μL of 100% ethanol and mix thoroughly by inversion (75% final concentration).
Incubate at -20°C for at least 2 hours.
Precool centrifuge to 4°C, chill 70% ethanol.
Pellet DNA by centrifugation at 21,000 rcf for 30 min (4°C).
Discard supernatant and wash pellet in 1 mL of 70% cold ethanol.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 21,000 rcf (4°C).
Remove ethanol and repeat ethanol wash for a total of two washes.
Spin in benchtop microcentrifuge and remove residual ethanol with a low volume pipette.
Air dry at room temperature (~20 min).
Resuspend DNA pellet in PCR grade water at 4°C overnight (Controls, 30 μL. 3C library: 137 μL).
Perform quantitative real-time PCR on control 1.
Determine digestion efficiency by quantitative real-time PCR on control 2.
Measure 3C library DNA concentration using 2 µL in a Qubit BR assay.
Store 3C library at -20°C.
Transfer 130 µL of 3C library to a Covaris microTUBE.
Sonicate DNA to achieve a size of 200 bp.
Mix sonicated DNA with Ampure XP SPRI beads by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Allow the mixture to bind at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand, discard liquid when clear (~5 min).
Add 700 μL of fresh 80% ethanol without disturbing the beads.
Allow the sample to sit on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds then remove ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash with an additional 700 µL of ethanol.
Remove all ethanol, spin tube in a microcentrifuge and replace on magnetic stand.
Remove residual ethanol using a P10 pipette without removing beads.
Air dry beads at room temperature on a magnetic stand until they appear matt.
Resuspend dried beads in 55 μL PCR grade water.
Incubate the resuspended mixture at room temperature for 2 minutes to elute DNA.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand and allow the beads to settle (~5 min).
Transfer 53 µL of supernatant containing eluted DNA into a new tube.
Assess sonication efficiency using 1 μL of DNA with a D1000 TapeStation.
Quantify recovered material using 2 μl in a BR Qubit assay.
Dilute sonicated DNA to achieve a concentration of up to 40 ng/μL.
Store the diluted sonicated DNA at -20°C.
Combine 50 µL of sonicated DNA (≤2 µg), 7 µL of 10x End Prep Buffer, and 3 µL of End Prep Enzyme in a PCR tube.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 20°C for 45 minutes followed by 65°C for 30 minutes with the lid set to 75°C.
Add 30 µL of Ultra II Ligation Master Mix, 7 µL of NEBNext Adaptor, and 1 µL of Ligation Enhancer to the mixture.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 20°C for 30 minutes with the lid off.
Add 3 µL of USER™ Enzyme to the mixture.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate in a thermocycle for 30 min at 37°C (lid: 47°C).
Transfer to a microcentrifuge tube containing 180 μL of AmpureXP Beads (1.8x).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Allow to bind at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnetic stand, discard liquid when clear (~5 min).
Add 700 μL of fresh 80% ethanol without removing from magnetic stand.
Avoid disturbing beads by running the ethanol down the front of tube.
Allow to sit on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds then remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash with a further 700 μL of ethanol.
Remove ethanol, spin tube on a microfuge and replace on magnetic stand.
Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, taking care not to remove any beads.
Air dry at room temperature on magnetic stand until matt in appearance – take care not to over dry the beads as this will result in increased DNA losses. Cracks will appear when beads have overdried.
Remove from magnetic stand and re-suspend beads in 60 μL PCR Grade water.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min to elute.
Place on magnetic stand and allow beads to clear (~5 min).
Assess adaptor ligation using 1 µL of DNA and a D1000 TapeStation.
Recover DNA by transferring 28.5 μL to each of two new PCR tubes.

To each PCR tube containing 28.5 μL of adaptor ligated library add: 5 μL of NEB Universal Primer, 5 μL NEB Index Primer, 10 μL 5x Herculase II buffer, 0.5 μL dNTP, and 1 μL of Herculase DNA polymerase.
Mix by pipetting up and down to combine the contents in each PCR tube.
Amplify DNA using the following conditions: Start with a denaturation step at 98°C for 30 seconds.
Continue with cycling: Denature at 98°C for 10 seconds, anneal at 65°C for 30 seconds, and extend at 72°C for 30 seconds. Repeat this cycle five times in total.
Perform a final extension step at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Hold the reaction at 4°C after amplification.
Combine identical reactions in a microcentrifuge tube containing 180 μL of AmpureXP Beads (1.8x).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times, allow to bind at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand, discard liquid when clear (~5 min).
Add 700 μL of fresh 80% ethanol without removing from magnetic stand.
Allow to sit on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds then remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash with 700 μL of ethanol.
Remove ethanol, spin tube on a microfuge and replace on magnetic stand.
Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, taking care not to remove any beads.
Air dry at room temperature on magnetic stand until matt in appearance.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min to elute.
Place on magnetic stand and allow beads to clear (~5 min).
Recover DNA by transferring 53 µL to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Assess indexing success using 1 µL of DNA and a D1000 TapeStation.
Quantify indexed 3C DNA using 2 µL in a Qubit BR reaction.
Reconstitute individual or pools of oligonucleotides to a stock concentration so that each unique oligonucleotide is stored at ≥1 µM.
Generate pools of oligonucleotides by mixing in exact 1:1 stoichiometric ratio.
Dilute pools of oligonucleotides so that each unique oligonucleotide is at 2.9 nM.
Resuspend Nimblegen oligonucleotides according to the Nimblegen protocol.
Add 120 µL PCR grade water to the HE Universal Oligo tube (1 mM) and vortex.
Add 10 µL PCR grade water to the HE Index Oligo tube (1 mM) and vortex.
Add 480 µL PCR Grade water to the Post-LM-PCR Oligos.
Heat vacuum centrifuge to 55°C.
Combine 1-2 μg of six differentially indexed samples at exactly 1:1 ratios by mass in a PCR tube.
Add 30 µL COT DNA (5 µL per library) to the combined sample.
Add 6 µL of TS-HE Universal oligo (1 µL per library) to the combined sample.
Add 1 µL of each index specific TS-HE index oligo to the combined sample.
Vacuum centrifuge at 55°C with tube lids open until sample is completely dry.
Preheat two thermocyclers, one to 95°C (lid: 105°C) and one to 47°C (lid: 47°C).
Add 7.5 µL of 2x Hybridisation Buffer per library to the mixture.
Add 3 µL of (Hybridisation Component A) per library to the mixture.
Spin down the mixture in a minifuge.
Preheat 4.5 µL of pooled biotinylated oligonucleotide probes per library on a 47°C thermocycler, with an additional 2 µL residual.
Denature the multiplexed 3C library mix by heating to 95°C for 10 minutes.
Transfer the denatured DNA tube to the 47°C thermocycler.
Add 27 µL of pre-warmed oligonucleotide probes to the denatured DNA, mixing gently.
Label the PCR machine to prevent accidental shutdown.
Incubate at 47°C for between 22 and 72 hours.
Preheat Thermomixer to 47°C.
Place Streptavidin beads on bench to reach room temperature.
Prepare stringent wash buffer: mix two tubes each containing 122 µL of 10x buffer and 1,098 µL of water per library.
Prepare wash buffer I: mix two tubes each with 94 µL of 10x buffer and 846 µL of water per library.
Prepare wash buffer II: mix one tube containing 124 µL of 10x buffer and 1,116 µL of water for all libraries.
Prepare wash buffer III: mix one tube with 124 µL of 10x buffer and 1,116 µL of water for all libraries.
Transfer 620 μL of Wash buffer I to a new tube.
Place the tube in the 47ºC thermomixer.
Add 600 µL of streptavidin beads (100 µL per library) into a low bind tube.
Place on magnetic stand and remove liquid once clear (~30 sec).
Add 1,200 μL of 1x Bead Wash buffer to the beads.
Vortex to re-suspend the beads, spin briefly and replace on magnet.
Remove liquid once clear (30 seconds).
Add 1,200 μL of 1x Bead Wash buffer for a second wash.
Vortex to re-suspend the beads, spin briefly and replace on magnet.
Remove liquid once clear (30 seconds).
Resuspend beads in 600 µL of 1x Bead Wash buffer (original volume of beads).
Vortex to re-suspend the beads, spin briefly and replace on magnet.
Briefly spin the hybridisation reaction to ensure it is at the bottom of the tube.
Replace the tube at 47ºC.
Remove Bead Wash buffer from streptavidin beads.
Transfer 90 µL hybridisation reaction to the streptavidin beads.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting 10 times.
Place on ThermoMixer at 47°C (600 rpm) for 45 min.
If beads settle out, pipette to resuspend.
Add 600 μL of 47°C 1x Wash buffer I (100 µL per library) to the bead mixture.
Mix by vortexing for 10 seconds, briefly spin to collect at bottom of the tube.
Place in magnetic stand and discard all the liquid when clear (~30 seconds).
Add 1,200 μL of heated Stringent Wash buffer (200 µL per library) and mix by vortexing.
Incubate on ThermoMixer for 5 minutes at 47°C, 600 rpm.
Briefly spin to collect at bottom of the tube.
Place in magnetic stand and discard all the liquid when clear (~30 seconds).
Add another 1,200 μL of heated Stringent Wash buffer (200 µL per library) and mix by vortexing.
Incubate on ThermoMixer for 5 minutes at 47°C, 600 rpm.
Briefly spin to collect at bottom of the tube.
Place in magnetic stand and discard all the liquid when clear (~30 seconds).
Remove from the stand and add 1,200 µL of room temperature 1x Wash buffer I (200 µL per library).
Mix by vortexing for 2 minutes.
Briefly spin to collect at bottom of the tube.
Place in magnetic stand and discard all the liquid when clear (~30 seconds).
Remove from the stand and add 1,200 μL of 1x Wash buffer II (200 µL per library).
Mix by vortexing for 1 minute.
Briefly spin to collect at bottom of the tube.
Place in magnetic stand and discard all the liquid when clear (~30 seconds).
Remove from the stand and add 1,200 µL of 1x Wash buffer III (200 µL per library).
Mix by vortexing for 30 sec.
Briefly spin to collect at bottom of the tube.
Place in magnetic stand and discard all liquid when clear (~30 sec).
Remove from the stand and add 240 µL of PCR grade water (40 µL per library).
To the 240 µL of bead bound DNA, add 300 µL KAPA HiFI HotStart ready Mix (50 µL per library) and 60 µL of POST-LM_PCR Oligo 1&2 (10 µL per library).
Mix by pipetting and separate across 12 PCR tubes (50 µL each, two tubes per library).
Amplify DNA using the following conditions: Lid at 108°C.
98°C for 45 sec.
98°C for 15 sec.
60°C for 30 sec.
72°C for 30 sec.
Repeat steps 2 to 4 for 10 total cycles.
72°C for 60 sec.
Hold at 4°C.
Transfer PCR tubes to a magnetic rack and allow solution to clear (~30 sec).
Combine amplification reactions into a single microcentrifuge tube with 1,080 µL of AmpureXP Beads (180 µL per library).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Allow to bind at room temperature for 5 min.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Discard the liquid when the mixture has become clear (~5 min).
Add 1,200 μL of fresh 80% ethanol without disturbing the beads.
Allow the sample to sit on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds then remove the ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash with an additional 1,200 µL of ethanol.
Remove the ethanol and spin the tube in a microcentrifuge.
Replace the tube on the magnetic stand after spinning.
Remove residual ethanol using a P10 pipette without disturbing any beads.
Air dry the sample at room temperature until it appears matt.
Take care not to overdry the beads as this can lead to increased DNA losses; cracks will appear when beads have overdried.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand and re-suspend the beads in 105 μL of PCR Grade water.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min to elute the DNA.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand and allow the beads to clear (~5 min).
Recover the DNA by transferring 103 µL into a new microcentrifuge tube.
Assess the size of captured DNA using 1 µL in a D1000 TapeStation with High Sensitivity reagents.
Quantify Captured 3C DNA using 2 µL in a Qubit HS reaction.
Preheat 7 µL of oligonucleotide pool for hybridization reaction.
Incubate the preheated oligonucleotide pool at 47ºC for between 18 and 22 hours.
Elute in 55 µL of PCR grade water after amplification of captured DNA.
Recover 53 µL of DNA.
Assess DNA size using 1 µL in a D1000 TapeStation with standard reagents.
Quantify Captured 3C DNA using 2 µL in a Qubit BR reaction.
Dilute 20 µL of Double Captured DNA to 10 nM for library sequencing using Qubit determined concentration.
Use KAPA Library Quantification Kit with 1:10,000 and 1:20,000 dilutions to determine concentration with size correction.
Determine the concentration of Double Captured DNA using KAPA.
Dilute Double Captured DNA to 4 nM or as specified by the Sequence Facility.
Sequence using paired-end reads.
Use 150 bp reads for gold standard sequencing to reconstruct entire indexed fragments and identify restriction sites.
Utilize 75 bp paired reads for sufficient analysis at lower cost.
